filled_text: Once there lived a deer.
He treated all the other animals well and even the lion respected him.
One day, a group of traders lost their way in the forest.
They didn't know what they could do.
The deer walked to them and led them out of the forest.
The leader of the traders was so moved.
He felt the king should know about that.
So the leader told the king about the deer.
However, the king paid no attention to the words praising the deer's kindness.
He just heard that there was a deer with the most beautiful antlers in the forest.
Then, the king decided to hunt the deer.
When he went into the forest with his soldiers, he said, "None of you should shoot at him. He belonged to me."
The king tried shooting the deer many times, but he didn't succeed.
As the king ran after the deer, he went deep into the forest.
Suddenly, the king fell into a hole and cried for help.
The deer ran to the hole and pulled him out with his antlers.
The king was so thankful to the deer that the deer was invited to the king's palace as a friend.
As we can see, if we can learn to help our enemies when they are helpless, we are sure to win friends.
Right?
filled_text_cn: 从前有一只鹿。
它对其他所有动物都很好，连狮子都很尊敬它。
一天，一群商人在森林里迷了路。
他们不知道该怎么办。
鹿走到他们身边，把他们带出了森林。
商队的首领非常感动。
他觉得国王应该知道这件事。
于是首领把关于这只鹿的事告诉了国王。
然而，国王并没有在意赞美鹿的善良的话语。
他只听说森林里有一只长着最美丽鹿角的鹿。
于是，国王决定去猎杀这只鹿。
当他和士兵们走进森林时，他说：“你们谁也不准向它开枪，它属于我。”
国王多次尝试射杀这只鹿，但都没有成功。
国王追着鹿，跑进了森林深处。
突然，国王掉进了一个洞里，大声呼救。
鹿跑到洞口，用鹿角把国王拉了出来。
国王对鹿非常感激，于是邀请鹿作为朋友住进了王宫。
正如我们所看到的，如果我们能学会在敌人无助时帮助他们，我们一定会赢得朋友。
对吗？

filled_text_cn: 志愿服务意味着某人无偿工作以帮助他人。
志愿者帮助那些真正需要帮助的人。
在很多地方你都可以看到不同的志愿者。
在校门口，你可以看到一些穿着红马甲的志愿者。

为了成为专业的交通志愿者，家长们应该学习如何给学生指路，并阻止他们在马路上踢足球。
因为有了这些志愿者，学生们可以安全地上下学。
《岳阳日报》报道称，许多家长都期待成为一名志愿者。
他们希望能努力保护学生的安全。
另一群“红马甲”出现在主干道上。
他们帮助清洁工捡起脏纸、塑料袋、玻璃瓶等垃圾。
他们劝导路人不要随地乱扔垃圾。
“请问您能带走您的垃圾吗？”“您介意把烟头捡起来吗？……”

一些青少年把空闲时间花在医院或敬老院里。
他们让生病的孩子开心起来，或者照顾老人。
在农村，一些大学生在志愿服务中发挥着重要作用。
他们可以为农民提供科技帮助。
一些志愿者在乡村学校担任教师。
许多志愿者伸出援手，传递善意。
他们能够给有需要的人和社会带来积极的影响。

filled_text: I live in a small city.
There, my father has an oil factory.
At the age of eight, something terrible happened while I was playing near an oil well.
It made me lose most of my hearing.
A lot has changed for me since then.
For one thing, I cannot hear music like before.
I used to love listening to my mother sing songs.
When I first lost my hearing, I was sad that I could never again hear my mother sing.
But now I put my ear to her chest to feel the vibrations of her voice.
Now, I feel music instead of hearing it.
Also, I have to go to a different school in another city—Texas School for the Deaf.
It is over 300 kilometers away from my hometown.
The teachers there are kind, but I can only see my parents during holidays.
I miss them very much.
During our last winter holiday, my daddy gave me a book The Story of My Life, by Helen Keller.
From it, I learned a lot about Helen Keller.
When she first became deaf and blind, she had a hard time showing people what she wanted.
Because of this, she would sometimes get mad and make loud noises.
Now I know her feelings and I am encouraged by the book.
filled_text_cn: 我住在一个小城市里。
在那里，我父亲有一家石油工厂。
八岁那年，当我在油井附近玩耍时，一件可怕的事情发生了。
它使我失去了大部分听力。
从那以后，我身上发生了很多变化。
一方面，我不能像以前那样听音乐了。
我过去很喜欢听妈妈唱歌。
刚开始失去听力时，我很难过，因为我再也听不到妈妈唱歌了。
但现在我会把耳朵贴在她的胸口，感受她声音的震动。
现在，我用感受来代替倾听音乐。
此外，我不得不去另一座城市的一所不同的学校——得克萨斯聋人学校上学。
它离我的家乡有三百多公里远。
那里的老师都很友善，但我只能在假期见到父母。
我非常想念他们。
去年寒假期间，爸爸送给我一本海伦·凯勒写的书《假如给我三天光明》（《我的一生》）。
从书中，我了解了很多关于海伦·凯勒的故事。
当她刚变得又聋又盲时，她很难向人们表达她想要什么。
正因为如此，她有时会发脾气并大声喧哗。
现在我理解了她的感受，也受到了这本书的鼓舞。

questions.rule_summary: 感官动词 hear 后接不带 to 的不定式作宾补。

sections.title: 练习 04 - Smile
raw_text: A smile shows that a person is happy.
For example, a person may smile when he or she is pleased with some progress in studies.
Or a person may smile if a friend tells a funny joke.
There are other good 1. ________ (reason) to smile often.
First, it is 2. ________ (easy) to smile than to show unhappiness.
In fact, it only takes 17 muscles (肌肉) to smile.
On the other hand, it takes 43 muscles to show unhappiness.
So 3. ________ (give) the muscles in your face a rest and smile!
Second, smiles are nice.
People may try to look nice by exercising or wearing nice clothes.
However, people often say a smile is the best thing a person can wear.
That is 4. ________ it is easy to be around someone who is smiling and happy.
Almost no one 5. ________ (want) to stay with someone who is always unhappy.
Third, smiles have power (感染力).
6. ________ smiling and laughing can easily and quickly spread from one person to another.
If one person smiles, people around him or her want to smile, too.
7. ________ (similar), when a person laughs, people tend (往往会) to laugh with him or her.
If a person is sad, the best thing to do is to share a smile or a laugh.
It is the easiest way to cheer someone 8. ________.
Finally, smiling and laughing are very good for the body.
Even though you are sad, try smiling.
You 9. ________ (find) that it will be difficult 10. ________ (stay) sad for very long!
filled_text: A smile shows that a person is happy.
For example, a person may smile when he or she is pleased with some progress in studies.
Or a person may smile if a friend tells a funny joke.
There are other good reasons to smile often.
First, it is easier to smile than to show unhappiness.
In fact, it only takes 17 muscles to smile.
On the other hand, it takes 43 muscles to show unhappiness.
So give the muscles in your face a rest and smile!
Second, smiles are nice.
People may try to look nice by exercising or wearing nice clothes.
However, people often say a smile is the best thing a person can wear.
That is because it is easy to be around someone who is smiling and happy.
Almost no one wants to stay with someone who is always unhappy.
Third, smiles have power.
Both smiling and laughing can easily and quickly spread from one person to another.
If one person smiles, people around him or her want to smile, too.
Similarly, when a person laughs, people tend to laugh with him or her.
If a person is sad, the best thing to do is to share a smile or a laugh.
It is the easiest way to cheer someone up.
Finally, smiling and laughing are very good for the body.
Even though you are sad, try smiling.
You will find that it will be difficult to stay sad for very long!
filled_text_cn: 微笑表明一个人很开心。
例如，当一个人对学习上的进步感到满意时，可能会微笑。
或者当朋友讲了一个有趣的笑话时，人也会微笑。
经常微笑还有其他很好的理由。
首先，微笑比表现出不开心更容易。
事实上，微笑只需要动用17块肌肉。
另一方面，表现出不开心需要动用43块肌肉。
所以让你脸上的肌肉休息一下，微笑吧！
其次，微笑很美好。
人们可能会通过锻炼或穿漂亮的衣服来让自己看起来更好看。
然而，人们常说微笑是一个人能穿戴的最好的东西。
那是因为和面带微笑、开心的人在一起很容易相处。
几乎没有人愿意和总是闷闷不乐的人待在一起。
第三，微笑具有感染力。
微笑和大笑都能轻松而迅速地从一个人传递给另一个人。
如果一个人微笑，他或她周围的人也会想微笑。
同样地，当一个人大笑时，人们往往也会跟着一起笑。
如果一个人难过，最好的办法就是分享一个微笑或一阵笑声。
这是让人振作起来最简单的方法。
最后，微笑和大笑对身体非常有好处。
即使你很难过，也要试着微笑。
你会发现，很难长时间保持难过的心情！

filled_text: Kevin is a special swimmer.
He took risks to swim in very cold places because he wanted people to pay attention to environmental problems.
As a boy, Kevin visited national parks and he learned the Earth is in poor condition.
He felt worried, and he wanted to protect the Earth.
In 2009, he went to swim in water near North Pole to draw people's attention to the melting glaciers.
Kevin said that the swim was so painful that it would be his last time swimming in cold water.
However, in 2016, he heard about a lake in the Himalayas.
It was formed by melting glaciers.
He decided to swim in cold water again.
It was difficult to swim in the lake.
It was such thin air that it was hard to breathe.
He told people about his experiences on TV.
He wanted people to know that glaciers in the Himalayas are disappearing because of global warming and that there's less water for people in nearby countries like China, India, and Pakistan.
From Kevin's story, we learn two lessons.
People can do a lot of harm to the Earth without realizing it.
Also, if we change the way we think, we can do something to protect our environment.
With the new way of thinking in our minds, we can enjoy a bright future.
filled_text_cn: 凯文是一位特别的游泳运动员。
他冒险在非常寒冷的地方游泳，因为他想让人们关注环境问题。
小时候，凯文参观过国家公园，了解到地球状况很糟糕。
他感到很担忧，想要保护地球。
2009年，他去北极附近的水域游泳，以引起人们对冰川融化的关注。
凯文说那次游泳太痛苦了，这将是他最后一次在冷水中游泳。
然而，在2016年，他听说了喜马拉雅山脉的一个湖泊。
它是由融化的冰川形成的。
他决定再次在冷水中游泳。
在这个湖里游泳非常困难。
空气如此稀薄，以至于呼吸都很困难。
他在电视上向人们讲述了自己的经历。
他想让人们知道，由于全球变暖，喜马拉雅山脉的冰川正在消失，中国、印度和巴基斯坦等周边国家的人们可用的水越来越少。
从凯文的故事中，我们学到了两个教训。
人们可能在不知不觉中对地球造成很大的伤害。
此外，如果我们改变思维方式，就能为保护环境做些事情。
有了新的思维方式，我们就能拥有一个光明的未来。

questions.explanation: 由不定冠词 a 和形容词 special 可知此处指人，swim 变名词表示“游泳者”需双写 m 加 -er，即 swimmer。
questions.rule_summary: 动词变表示人的名词常加 -er/-or，注意双写规则。

questions.explanation: 由从句谓语 wanted 可知主句应用一般过去时，take 的过去式为 took。
questions.rule_summary: 主从句时态保持一致，take 的过去式为 took。

questions.explanation: draw one's attention to 表示“引起某人对……的注意”，people 的所有格为 people's。
questions.rule_summary: 不以 s 结尾的复数名词所有格直接加 's。

questions.explanation: so + adj. + that 从句表示“如此……以至于……”，故填 that。
questions.rule_summary: so...that... 引导结果状语从句。

questions.explanation: 由 by melting glaciers 可知为被动语态，且湖泊形成于过去，故用一般过去时被动语态 was formed。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时被动语态为 was/were + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: it is/was + adj. + to do sth. 表示“做某事是……的”，故填 to breathe。
questions.rule_summary: it is + adj. + to do sth. 为固定句型。

questions.explanation: on TV 为固定搭配，意为“在电视上”，类似还有 on the radio/phone/Internet。
questions.rule_summary: 表示“在电视/网络/广播上”用介词 on。

questions.explanation: 根据语境，由于全球变暖水资源变得更少，little 的比较级为 less，修饰不可数名词 water。
questions.rule_summary: little 的比较级为 less，修饰不可数名词。

questions.explanation: 介词 without 后接动名词，表示“没有意识到”，故填 realizing。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后动词需用动名词形式。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一个光明的未来”，bright 以辅音音素开头，故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指单数可数名词，辅音音素开头用 a。

sections.title: 练习 06 - Marco Polo and China
raw_text: Marco Polo was born in Italy in 1254.
When he was 17, he travelled along the Silk Road with his father, who wanted to do trade with the Chinese.
Finally, they arrived in Beijing.
They were guests at the Emperor's Palace.
1. ________ Marco was young, he was very clever and could speak four languages.
The Emperor was impressed by him and they became friends.
The Emperor asked Marco to help him and 2. ________ (send) him to do many important jobs all over the country.
Marco 3. ________ (amaze) by how great China was.
He was impressed by the Emperor's Palace 4. ________ he described as "The 5. ________ (great) palace that I've ever seen".
The walls were covered 6. ________ gold and silver and the hall was so large.
Marco was also attracted by lots of strange things in China.
Marco was surprised 7. ________ (see) Chinese people using paper money in the markets.
In Europe, people paid for goods with gold and silver.
He could not understand how people paid for food and 8. ________ (value) things with paper!
He was also puzzled by the black stones people used to burn to produce heat.
The black stones were coal, but Marco had never 9. ________ (see) coal before!
After he served the Emperor for 17 years, in 1291, Marco returned to 10. ________ (Italian).

filled_text: Marco Polo was born in Italy in 1254.
When he was 17, he travelled along the Silk Road with his father, who wanted to do trade with the Chinese.
Finally, they arrived in Beijing.
They were guests at the Emperor's Palace.
Although Marco was young, he was very clever and could speak four languages.
The Emperor was impressed by him and they became friends.
The Emperor asked Marco to help him and sent him to do many important jobs all over the country.
Marco was amazed by how great China was.
He was impressed by the Emperor's Palace which he described as "The greatest palace that I've ever seen".
The walls were covered with gold and silver and the hall was so large.
Marco was also attracted by lots of strange things in China.
Marco was surprised to see Chinese people using paper money in the markets.
In Europe, people paid for goods with gold and silver.
He could not understand how people paid for food and valuable things with paper!
He was also puzzled by the black stones people used to burn to produce heat.
The black stones were coal, but Marco had never seen coal before!
After he served the Emperor for 17 years, in 1291, Marco returned to Italy.
He had a lot of money then.
A writer wrote down all the stories that Marco told him in a book called The Description of the World, which became one of the best-selling books in Europe.
filled_text_cn: 马可·波罗于1254年出生在意大利。
17岁时，他随父亲沿着丝绸之路旅行，父亲想和中国人做贸易。
最终，他们抵达了北京。
他们成了皇宫里的客人。
虽然马可很年轻，但他非常聪明，会说四种语言。
皇帝对他印象深刻，两人成了朋友。
皇帝请马可帮忙，并派他到全国各地处理许多重要事务。
马可被中国的伟大所震撼。
他对皇宫印象深刻，并将其形容为“我见过的最宏伟的宫殿”。
墙壁上覆盖着金银，大厅也非常宽敞。
马可还被中国的许多新奇事物所吸引。
马可惊讶地看到中国人在市场上使用纸币。
在欧洲，人们用金银购买商品。
他无法理解人们怎么能用纸来购买食物和贵重物品！
他还对人们用来燃烧取暖的黑色石头感到困惑。
那些黑色石头是煤，但马可以前从未见过煤！
在为皇帝效力17年后，1291年，马可回到了意大利。
那时他已经很富有了。
一位作家把马可讲述的所有故事记录在一本名为《马可·波罗游记》的书中，这本书成了欧洲最畅销的书籍之一。

questions.explanation: 前后句意为“尽管很年轻，但他非常聪明”，表示让步关系，故填 Although（或 Though）。
questions.rule_summary: Although/Though 引导让步状语从句，不与 but 连用。

questions.explanation: 与 asked 并列作谓语，均用一般过去时，send 的过去式为 sent。
questions.rule_summary: and 连接并列谓语，时态保持一致。

questions.explanation: be amazed by 表示“对……感到惊奇”，由全文过去时态可知应用 was amazed。
questions.rule_summary: be amazed by 表示“被……震惊/惊奇”。

questions.explanation: 先行词为 the Emperor's Palace（指物），关系词在定语从句中作 described 的宾语，故填 which（或 that）。
questions.rule_summary: 定语从句先行词指物且作宾语时用 which/that。

questions.explanation: 由定语从句 that I've ever seen 及前面的 The 可知此处用最高级 greatest。
questions.rule_summary: “the + 形容词最高级 + that sb. have ever done”表“最……的”。

questions.explanation: be covered with 为固定搭配，意为“被……覆盖”，故填 with。
questions.rule_summary: be covered with 表示“被……覆盖”。

questions.explanation: be surprised to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“惊讶于做某事”，故填 to see。
questions.rule_summary: be surprised to do sth. 表示“做某事很惊讶”。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 things 应用形容词，value 的形容词形式为 valuable“贵重的、有价值的”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词需用形容词形式。

questions.explanation: had + 过去分词构成过去完成时，see 的过去分词为 seen。
questions.rule_summary: 过去完成时结构为 had + 过去分词。

questions.rule_summary: return to + 地点名词，表示“返回某地”。

sections.title: 练习 07 - Rabbit in Chinese and Western Culture
raw_text: Rabbit is the 1. ________ (four) of the 12 Chinese zodiac (生肖) parts, in the order of Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Pig.
2. ________ rabbits are gentle and smart, they are very popular with people from all over the world.
In China, rabbits are considered 3. ________ (be) a lucky sign.
That's because rabbits can have many babies in the nature, even in terrible conditions.
In the past, people thought 4. ________ more children they had, the better their life would be.

Ancient Chinese people 5. ________ (believe) a rabbit was living on the moon.
It is called the Moon Rabbit and helps Chang'e, a goddess who is 6. ________ (wide) known in China, to make medicine.
Similarly, rabbits 7. ________ (see) to be lucky in Western culture.

filled_text: Rabbit is the fourth of the 12 Chinese zodiac parts, in the order of Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Pig.
Because rabbits are gentle and smart, they are very popular with people from all over the world.
In China, rabbits are considered to be a lucky sign.
That's because rabbits can have many babies in the nature, even in terrible conditions.
In the past, people thought the more children they had, the better their life would be.
The rabbit can make people think of the moon.
Ancient Chinese people believed a rabbit was living on the moon.
It is called the Moon Rabbit and helps Chang'e, a goddess who is widely known in China, to make medicine.
Similarly, rabbits are seen to be lucky in Western culture.
There are some traditions about how to get the rabbit's good luck for yourself.
For example, a rabbit's foot is one of the most famous symbols of good luck and the person who holds it is supposed to be lucky.
Also, people usually say the word "rabbit" on the first morning of every month.
They're looking forward to bringing themselves good luck for this whole month.
filled_text_cn: 兔是中国十二生肖中的第四位，顺序为鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪。
因为兔子温和又聪明，所以它们深受世界各地人们的喜爱。
在中国，兔子被视为吉祥的象征。
那是因为兔子在自然界中即使在恶劣的条件下也能生育很多后代。
过去，人们认为孩子越多，生活就会越好。
兔子能让人联想到月亮。
中国古人相信月亮上住着一只兔子。
它被称为玉兔，帮助在中国广为人知的女神嫦娥捣药。
同样，在西方文化中，兔子也被视为幸运的象征。
有一些关于如何为自己获得兔子好运的传统。
例如，兔脚是最著名的好运象征之一，拥有它的人被认为会很幸运。
此外，人们通常在每个月的第一个早晨说“rabbit”这个词。
他们期待着这能为自己带来整整一个月的好运。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 the 后表示顺序“第四”，应用序数词 fourth。
questions.rule_summary: 表示顺序“第几”时，the 后接序数词。

questions.explanation: 前因后果，“因为兔子温和聪明，所以很受欢迎”，用 Because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.rule_summary: Because 引导原因状语从句。

questions.explanation: be considered to be 为固定搭配，意为“被认为是、被视为”，故填 to be。
questions.rule_summary: be considered to be 表示“被视为”。

questions.explanation: “the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...”表示“越……，就越……”，故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: the + 比较级，the + 比较级表示“越……越……”。

questions.explanation: 由 Ancient Chinese people 可知叙述古代的事情，应用一般过去时 believed。
questions.rule_summary: 描述过去或古代的事实用一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 is known 应用副词 widely，意为“广泛地”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词/过去分词需用副词。

questions.explanation: 主语 rabbits 与 see 为被动关系“被视作”，陈述客观文化事实用一般现在时，故填 are seen。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时被动语态：am/is/are + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词，表示“最……的之一”，故填 the most famous。
questions.rule_summary: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

questions.rule_summary: 具体某一天的早、中、晚前用介词 on。

questions.rule_summary: look forward to doing sth. 表示“期待做某事”。

sections.title: 练习 08 - Dragon Head-Raising Day
raw_text: The dragon is 1. ________ great animal in Chinese culture.
People say that it brings wind and rain.
It 2. ________ (say) that on the second day of the second lunar month every year, the dragon wakes up from its winter sleep and 3. ________ (raise) its head.

5. ________ one that has remained popular is to have a haircut.
Many believe that a haircut during the first lunar month may bring bad 6. ________ (luck) to their uncles— 7. ________ (main) their mothers' brothers.

filled_text: The dragon is a great animal in Chinese culture.
People say that it brings wind and rain.
It is said that on the second day of the second lunar month every year, the dragon wakes up from its winter sleep and raises its head.
Because of this, the day is called "Dragon Head-Raising Day".
Some people see it as the start of spring and farming, because they believe that there will be more rain after it.
And rain is important to farming.
Today, many customs have faded away.
But one that has remained popular is to have a haircut.
Many believe that a haircut during the first lunar month may bring bad luck to their uncles—mainly their mothers' brothers.
So many people have their hair cut on Dragon Head-Raising Day.
Also, it is tradition for people to eat some food on that day.
The food is usually named after dragons.
Noodles are called dragon's beard (longxu).
Dumplings are dragon's ears (long'er).
And spring rolls are dragon's scales (longlin).
In some places in Shandong, people make dragon lanterns and put them on slow boats on the rivers.
The activity stands for people's best wishes and good luck.
filled_text_cn: 龙在中国文化中是一种伟大的动物。
人们说它能呼风唤雨。
据说每年农历二月初二，龙会从冬眠中醒来并抬起头。
正因如此，这一天被称为“龙抬头”。
有些人把它看作春天和农耕的开始，因为他们相信这之后会有更多的雨水。
而雨水对农耕非常重要。
如今，许多习俗已经逐渐消失。
但一个仍然流行的习俗是理发。
许多人认为在正月理发会给舅舅——主要是母亲的兄弟——带来厄运。
所以很多人在龙抬头这一天理发。
此外，在这一天吃一些特定食物也是人们的传统。
这些食物通常以龙来命名。
面条被称为龙须。
饺子被称为龙耳。
春卷则被称为龙鳞。
在山东的一些地方，人们制作龙灯并放在河里的慢船上。
这项活动代表着人们最美好的祝愿和好运。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一种伟大的动物”，great 以辅音音素开头，故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 泛指单数可数名词，辅音音素开头用 a。

questions.explanation: It is said that... 为固定句型，意为“据说……”，故填 is said。
questions.rule_summary: It is said that... 表示“据说……”。

questions.explanation: 与 wakes up 并列，主语 the dragon 为第三人称单数，且有 every year，故填 raises。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时三单主语，并列谓语均用三单形式。

questions.explanation: 根据句意“在龙抬头之后将会有更多的雨”，应用 there be 句型的一般将来时 will be。
questions.rule_summary: there will be 表示“将会有……”。

questions.explanation: 前句说“许多习俗逐渐消失”，后句说“理发仍然流行”，前后为转折关系，故填 But。
questions.rule_summary: 句意转折时用 But 衔接。

questions.explanation: 形容词 bad 后接不可数名词 luck，bad luck 意为“坏运气、厄运”。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词修饰名词，luck 为不可数名词。

questions.explanation: 此处表示“主要是”，应用副词 mainly 作状语。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰短语或作补充说明用副词 mainly。

questions.explanation: have sth. done 表示“请人做某事”，have their hair cut 意为“理发”，cut 的过去分词仍为 cut。
questions.rule_summary: have sth. done 表示“让某事被做”。

questions.explanation: it 作形式主语，不定式 to eat some food on that day 作真正主语，此处用不可数名词 tradition 作表语，意为“吃某些食物是传统”。
questions.rule_summary: it is tradition for sb. to do sth. 表示“做某事是传统”。

questions.explanation: stand for 为固定短语，意为“代表、象征”，故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: stand for 表示“代表”。

sections.title: 练习 09 - My Days in Basketball Camp
raw_text: Dear Dad,
How is everything going?
After three days of basketball camp in Canada, I am still alive and I still like basketball.
In fact, this 1. ________ (be) a really different week so far!
On Monday morning, I practised in a group with nine other kids.
We 2. ________ (choose) a cool name for our team.

filled_text: You may know about "junk food" like French fries.
But do you know about "junk sleep"?
Recently, a British survey shows that there are many electronic products in teenagers' bedrooms.
They are influencing teenagers' sleep badly.
The survey was done among 1,000 British kids from 12 to 16.
It found that 50% of them got just 4 to 7 hours' sleep every day.
But doctors say they need 8 to 9 hours.
Almost 25% of the kids said they often fell asleep while they were watching TV, listening to music or using other electronic products.
"This is very worrying," said Dr. Chris, a British professor.
"We call it 'junk sleep'. It means you don't get enough sleep and the quality of the sleep is low, too. If you don't get a good rest, you won't do well in school the next day."
The survey found that quite a few of the kids felt tired each day because of the junk sleep, especially girls between 13 and 16 feeling the worst.
Nearly all the teenagers have a phone, MP5 or TV in their bedrooms.
And lots of them even have all the three.
Dr. Chris suggested that parents should help their children keep away from electronic products, and teenagers should spend less time on the electronic products.
filled_text_cn: 你可能知道像炸薯条这样的“垃圾食品”。
但你知道“垃圾睡眠”吗？
最近，英国的一项调查显示，青少年的卧室里有很多电子产品。
它们正在严重影响青少年的睡眠。
这项调查是在1000名12至16岁的英国孩子中进行的。
调查发现，其中50%的人每天只睡4到7个小时。
但医生表示，他们需要8到9个小时的睡眠。
近25%的孩子说，他们经常在看电视、听音乐或使用其他电子产品时睡着。
“这非常令人担忧，”英国教授克里斯博士说。
“我们称之为‘垃圾睡眠’。这意味着你没有得到足够的睡眠，而且睡眠质量也很低。如果你没有好好休息，第二天在学校就不会表现好。”
调查发现，相当多的孩子因为垃圾睡眠每天都感到疲惫，尤其是13至16岁的女孩感觉最糟。
几乎所有青少年的卧室里都有手机、MP5或电视。
很多人甚至三样都有。
克里斯博士建议父母应该帮助孩子远离电子产品，青少年也应该在电子产品上少花时间。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 influencing 应用副词，bad 的副词形式为 badly“严重地”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词需用副词形式。

questions.explanation: 主语 The survey 与 do 为被动关系“被进行”，由后句 found 可知为一般过去时，故填 was done。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时被动语态：was/were + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: 4 to 7 后接复数名词 hours，且修饰名词 sleep 需用所有格，以 s 结尾的复数名词直接加 '，即 hours'。
questions.rule_summary: 以 s 结尾的复数名词所有格直接加 '。

questions.explanation: while 引导时间状语从句常接进行时，主句 fell 为过去时，主语 they 为复数，故填 were watching。
questions.rule_summary: while 引导过去时间状语从句常用过去进行时。

questions.explanation: 主语 This 指代上文的情况（事物），is 后接形容词 worrying“令人担忧的”（worried 修饰人）。
questions.rule_summary: -ing 形容词修饰物，-ed 形容词修饰人。

questions.explanation: get a good rest 为固定短语，意为“好好休息”，故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: have/get a good rest 表示“好好休息”。

questions.explanation: if 引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时否定 won't do。
questions.rule_summary: if 引导条件状语从句：主句一般将来时，从句一般现在时。

questions.explanation: because of 后接名词短语 the junk sleep，表示原因“因为”，故填 because。
questions.rule_summary: because of + 名词/短语，表示“因为”。

questions.explanation: keep away from 为固定短语，意为“远离”，故填 from。
questions.rule_summary: keep away from 表示“远离”。

questions.explanation: 根据句意“青少年应该在电子产品上少花时间”，修饰不可数名词 time 用 little 的比较级 less。
questions.rule_summary: little 的比较级为 less，修饰不可数名词。

More than 1.4 million toy mascots were sold during the Games.
Bing Dwen Dwen was the center of people's attention at that time.

filled_text_cn: 大熊猫“冰墩墩”是2022年北京冬奥会的吉祥物。
冬奥会期间售出了超过140万个吉祥物玩具。

2023年五一假期期间，约有26.4万人来到成都看望大熊猫“花花”。
成都成为了中国第二大热门旅游目的地。
花花很快就要三岁了，因为它不会爬树而且很友好，俘获了游客们的心。
事实上，许多年轻人去成都旅游就是为了看大熊猫。
今年五一假期前三天的全部18万张门票都售罄了。
花花带动了熊猫基地的门票销售。
成都有许多充满熊猫文创产品的文创商店。
店里关于熊猫的服装、鞋帽、周边产品也卖得很好。
正如我们所看到的，“大熊猫经济”再次成为消费领域的一大亮点。

questions.rule_summary: 不以 s 结尾的复数名词所有格直接加 's。

filled_text: A woman kept a bird and she really liked it.
But one day the bird flew away.
The woman was sad and went out to look for it on the mountain near her home.
At last, she met the bird.
The woman said excitedly, "Will you please go home with me, my bird?"
Though the bird was also happy to see the woman, it shook its head.
"Take me to your home and let me see how you live." the woman said.
The bird led the woman to its new home.
She found it lived well with many other birds.
So she decided to go back home alone.
When she was leaving, the bird gave her a basket.
When she returned home, she told her husband what had happened.
Her husband opened the basket and saw a lot of gold.
The man was very greedy and he went to the bird's home, too.
"Hello, my bird. I miss you very much." cried the man falsely.
In fact, he used to treat the bird badly.
The bird said nothing.
It took out two baskets, a light one and a heavy one.
The bird asked him to choose one and he could open it after he reached home.
Of course, he chose the heavy one and took it home with great difficulty.
However, when he opened the basket, he found it was full of stones!
filled_text_cn: 一位妇人养了一只鸟，她非常喜欢它。
但有一天，这只鸟飞走了。
妇人很伤心，出门到家附近的山上寻找它。
最后，她找到了那只鸟。
妇人激动地说：“我的鸟儿，请你跟我回家好吗？”
虽然小鸟见到妇人也很高兴，但它摇了摇头。
“带我去你家，让我看看你是怎么生活的。”妇人说。
小鸟把妇人带到了它的新家。
她发现小鸟和许多其他鸟儿一起生活得很好。
于是她决定独自回家。
当她正要离开时，小鸟送给了她一个篮子。
回到家后，她把发生的事情告诉了丈夫。
她丈夫打开篮子，看到了许多金子。
这个男人非常贪婪，他也去了小鸟的家。
“你好，我的鸟儿。我非常想你。”男人虚伪地喊道。
事实上，他过去对这只鸟很不好。
小鸟什么也没说。
它拿出两个篮子，一个轻的，一个重的。
小鸟让他选一个，并且回到家后才能打开。
当然，他选了那个重的，费了很大力气才把它拿回家。
然而，当他打开篮子时，却发现里面装满了石头！

questions.explanation: 故事发生在过去，用一般过去时，fly 的过去式为 flew。
questions.rule_summary: fly 的过去式为不规则变化 flew。

questions.explanation: look for 为固定短语，意为“寻找”，故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: look for 表示“寻找”。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 said 应用副词，excited 的副词形式为 excitedly“激动地”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词需用副词形式。

questions.explanation: be happy to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“很高兴做某事”，故填 to see。
questions.rule_summary: be happy to do sth. 表示“很高兴做某事”。

questions.explanation: 故事为一般过去时，shake 的过去式为 shook。
questions.rule_summary: shake 的过去式为不规则变化 shook。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 new home 应用形容词性物主代词 its“它的”。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词 its（注意与 it's 区分）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 过去进行时表过去将来
questions.explanation: 句意为“当她正要离开时，鸟给了她一个篮子”，位移动词 leave 用过去进行时 was leaving 表示过去将来。
questions.rule_summary: 位移动词（go/come/leave）可用进行时表将来。

questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺少主语，指代“发生的事情”，应用连接代词 what。
questions.rule_summary: 宾语从句缺主语/宾语且指物时用 what。

questions.explanation: 形容词 great 后接名词，with great difficulty 意为“非常费力地”，故填 difficulty。
questions.rule_summary: with difficulty 表示“困难地/费力地”。

questions.explanation: 前后句构成转折关系，且空后有逗号隔开，应用 However（but 后不加逗号）。
questions.rule_summary: 表转折且后有逗号时用 However。
